baselineMethod: git archive of exact origin/main6537 snapshot in an owned temporary directory; shared locked node_modules; wxt prepare then standard userscript Vite build. Main checkout and tracked snapshot sources remain unchanged.

baselineBuild.command: node scripts/testing/run-resource-safe.mjs -- node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config userscript/vite.config.ts

incrementScope: Shared settings config-editor/controller lifecycle preserves pending and failed drafts; SettingsSections uses the same implementation in extension and userscript full settings.
Shared removeConfiguredModel command removes every model preference, including userscript request limits, through the existing config draft.
Translation preflight/identity/template logic is shared across app and userscript through application services; dependency moves do not introduce a parallel runtime.
languageResources: Same immutable resource commit and five published dictionary filenames/content; extension-only document config copy is excluded and new section-sweep copy is added at registration.
assertions: Only the measured size budget and its explanation changed; all metadata, resource, exclusion, duplicate-injection and isolated VM compatibility assertions remain byte-identical.
measurementLimit: Delta is measured for the complete minified artifact; incrementScope identifies shared consumers rather than claiming additive per-module byte attribution.
